project.name: Yggdrasil World Engine
project.summary: Code-agnostic cosmic narrative simulation engine based on the ASH cosmological model

principles: Native-first: engine implementations use native idioms
Boundary-first: dependency direction is intentional and enforced
Policy-first: ASH compliance rules are hard constraints
Host-agnostic modules: core specification is engine-agnostic

layers.name: Core
layers.role: Engine interfaces, cosmology rules, pattern detection logic, invariants

layers.name: Data
layers.role: JSON schemas, data loading, registry parsing, data models

layers.name: Runtime
layers.role: Quest generation, myth formation, prophecy tracking, creature spawning

layers.name: Presentation
layers.role: Realm overlays, perception rendering, UI integration, temporary environments

layers.name: Editor
layers.role: Build tools, inspectors, world builders, testing utilities

cosmological_invariants: Nine canonical realms are fixed and immutable
Realms are cosmological states, not locations
White Wolf and Dark Wolf emerge with Divine Core creation as paired companions of consciousness and cannot die permanently
Divine Core is the origin center of all reality
All procedural generation derives from ASH pattern detection
No independent random generators for meaningful content
Wolf alignment is accumulation-only, never subtracted
Bloodlines influence cosmic eligibility, never lock destiny
The world does not change; player perception changes
Prophecies are probability weights, not fixed scripts
